_help: Detections entered or approved by MDA staff. These always win over automatic ones. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Premises locations are NOT stored here; add them in the regulator layer.
read_urls_help: Paste official release addresses (mda.maryland.gov, news.delaware.gov, vdacs.virginia.gov) here. The AI reads them on the next run and adds detections automatically.
